title: WorldPedia
description: Adds a clean and simple health indicator above mobs and players.
body:
# Worldpedia

A lightweight, high-performance client-side mod that displays a clean health indicator directly above the names of mobs and players. 

## 🌟 Features
* **1:1 Health Display**: See the exact health of any living entity in real-time.
* **Vanilla Style**: The indicator integrates seamlessly with the default Minecraft name tags using a clean text format.
* **Pure Client-Side**: Works perfectly on multiplayer servers without needing the mod installed on the server side!

## 🚀 Requirements
* **Fabric Loader**
